config.reward: visible score difference only, constant scale for optimizer
config.training_policy: learned Q-values with training-only persistent uniform random exploration
config.replay_resume: refill from new own experience; no saved trajectories loaded
config.resume_semantics: online, target, optimizer and RNG restored; episodes restart from boot
config.exploration_duration: bounded power law proportional to length**(-exponent)
config.exploration_epsilon: nominal uninterrupted exploratory-step fraction; boundary cuts can reduce it
config.exploration_warmup: unchanged independent uniform actions until replay warmup
config.exploration_reset: cancel on visible ship loss, termination or truncation; no screen-triggered starts
config.exploration_resume: restore separate RNG; active holds and local counters clear with new boot episodes
